Codex App 终于支持 windows 了

OpenAI 的 Codex App 正式登陆 Windows，支持原生运行，也支持 WSL（Windows 子系统，让 Windows 用户跑 Linux 环境的工具）。终端方面全面兼容 PowerShell、命令提示符、Git Bash 和 WSL，覆盖了大多数 Windows 开发者的日常习惯。

最值得关注的是沙盒机制。Codex 在 Windows 上构建了一套原生的智能体沙盒，通过操作系统层面的控制，限制 AI 只能在你指定的工作目录内写文件，同时默认阻断对外网络请求，除非你手动放行。AI 编码助手在执行任务时权限过宽一直是业界隐患，这套设计在功能可用性和安全边界之间做了明确的取舍。

此次更新还新增了 7 个"在 XXX 中打开"应用集成，以及两个 Windows 专属技能：WinUI（Windows 原生界面开发框架）和 https://t.co/bd7IOj2iWD。

Huawei’s HIMA (Hongmeng Zhixing) says it has delivered 1.28 million vehicles cumulatively as of March 3, 2026. Richard Yu shared the figure at today’s product refresh.

It took 43 months to reach the first million deliveries, which the company says is the fastest pace among China’s new-energy newcomers. Huawei also claims HIMA has ranked No. 1 in average transaction price among Chinese auto brands for 14 straight months. February deliveries were 28,212 units, up 31% year over year.

The pricing point is the most interesting part. In this setup, Huawei does not own the factories. It brings the software stack, connectivity, and brand pull, while OEM partners build the cars. If the brand is consistently selling at the highest average prices, that suggests buyers are paying for the Huawei layer, not only the sheet metal.

An asset-light model that still produces premium pricing is hard to maintain. For now, the reported numbers suggest it is working.
